content: Jana Jesus yarkinkaku kuninka.

Warngku jambulmal, bama wubulku murumarinka, big day holiday Passover haveim-bunganka, one week holiday Unleavened Bread haveim-bunganka. Maja-majangka Godundumunku bayanka, teacher-teacherangka ngadimunku, jana Jesus kiraynjaku karrbanka, yarkinkaku kuninka.
Jana jana-karrajiku balkawan, “Kari karrba bamanda miyilba. Jana nganangan nyajinji, kuninji.”
Nyubunyinja jalbungku jila mini-mini nyangarrin Jesusanda.

Nyulu Jesus townbu Bethany dungan, mayi nukanka Simonanji. Ngadiku Simon baji-bajiman, leprosymunji, yamba nyulu nyiku yalada. Jesus mayinga nukal-nukajin, jalbu nyungundu kadan bottleji jilaji mini-miniji. Yinya jila mini-mini burri nard, dear-bala bajaku, moneybu yalbaynja bajabuku manin. Nyulu jalbungku bottle dumbarrin, jila mini-mini Jesusanda dukulbu nyangarrin.
Bama kanbal jalbunku kuli-kadarin, jana-karrajiku balkawan, “Nyulu wanyurrinku jila mini-mini wumbabuku nyangarrinyarrkuda? Wanyurrinku wasteim-bungan?
Ngana yinya jila mini-mini sellim-bunganyaku moneyka yalbaynka, 300 dollarsmunku, money bamanga money-karingakuda dajinyaku.” Jana jalbu murru-kanganda.
Yamba Jesusangka yalaman, “Nyungun bawa, yurra wanyurrinku nyungu kuli dajil-dajil? Nyulu ngaykundu ngulkurr balkan.
Yurranji bama money-kari wuljaljiku bundandari. Yurra wawubu, yurra janangan ngulkurrduku kuji. Yamba ngayu kari wuljaljiku yurranji bunday.
Nyulu ngaykundu nyangarrin bangkarrba, nganya yanday-bunganka, jana nganya juljalba nandanka.” Bama Jew-warra yalaku, yarkin jilabu mini-minibu julngkan, nandanjiku.

Jesusangka yalaman baja, “Ngayu yurranda manubajabuku balkal. Bamangka juma kuku ngaykunku balkal bubungu yindu-yinduymbu, yiringkurrku. Jana yinyaynka jalbunku balkal, bama binalmanka nyulu ngulkurr balkan ngaykundu.”
Judasangka Jesus mambarrinka.
Wawu yinyamun nyubun bama jawun-karrandamun, burri Judas Iscariot, nyulu maja-majanda Godundumunbu bayanba dungan, jananda Jesus mambarrinka.
Jana maja-majangka Judas nyajin, jana wawurr-wawurrmaynda. Jana nyungunin moneyka wawurr-wawurr-bungan, nyulu jananda Jesus mambarrinka. Judasangka good chance kujil-kujin, Jesus mambarrinka.
Jesusangka Passover mayi nukan jawun-karranji.

First day holidaymunku Passovermunku kadan. Jana Jew-warra yalaku, jana first daymunbu minya sheep karrkay kuninya, minyaka Passovermunku. Jesusandamundu jawun-karrangka nyungundu yalaman, “Nganjin wanjabu dungari, minya wayjunku, Passover nukanka?”
Nyulu jawunyundu jambulimba yalaman, “Yubal townbu Jerusalem dungay, dingkar maku-nyajil, bucketji bana jarra-kulbal-kulbanya. Nyungun wukurrika.
Bayanba wukurrika, maja bayanka babajika, ‘Nyulu Teacherangka Jesusangka babajin, “Room wanjaku, ngayu, and ngaykuwundu jawun-karrangka mayi Passover nukanka?” ’
Nyulu yubalin wangkar-wangkar wundil, roommunbu yalbaymba, tableji, chairji. Yubal minya yinyaymba wayju.”
Bula townbu dungan, junjuy-junjuy warrmba-bungan yala Jesusangkaku balkan. Bula minya wayjunda.
Wungar daran, Jesus jawun-karranji kanbalanji kadan.
Jana mayinga nukal-nukajin, Jesusangka yalaman, “Ngayu yurrangan manubajabuku balkal, yurra ngaykunji nukan-nukaji, nyubunyinja nganya mambarril maja-majanda.”
Jana milka-bujarmanda, nyubun-nyubunyinjaku Jesusanda babajin, “Wanjungku? Ngayu?”
Nyulu jananda yalaman, “Yurrandamun 12-balandamun nyubunyinja nganya mambarrilkuda. Nyulu yinyangkakudabi bread ngabal milkulbu ngaykunji.
Ngayu bamanga wubulbuku yaba. Godundumunbu kabanda ngaykunku balkal, ngayu wulaykuda. Yamba kuli jirray kaday bamanda nganya mambarril. Nyulu jakalbaku kari balkajinyaku.”
Kuku Communionmunku.
Jana mayingada nukan-nukajin, Jesusangka bread manin, breadka God thankim-bungan, bread dumbarrin, jawun-karranda dajin, yalaman, “Mana, nukada. Yanyu bread ngayku bangkarr.”
Nyulu cup winemunji manin, God thankim-bungan, jananda dajin. Jana wubulinjaku nukaynda, yinyamun cupmun.
Nyulu jananda yalaman, “Yanyu ngayku mula. Godungku promise dajin bamanda. Ngayku mula warri, yinya kuku manubajamalkuda. Ngayu mula dajil bamanka wubulkuku.
Ngayu yurranda manubajabuku balkal, ngayu wine yalanguy kari nukal baja. Ngayu juma bubunguku kaday baja, God majakuda wubulkuku. Ngayu yurranjida nukal baja, wine walu-yindu.”
Yinyamun jana wulngku badin, God buyay-maninka. Jana dungarinda wuburrbu burri Olive.
Jesusangka balkan Peterangka nyungun darrbinka.
Jesusangka jananda yalaman, “Dingkar-dingkar kadari, nganya karrbanka. Yurra yinyiljiku warrida, ngakiji jananka. Godundumundu kabanda balkan,

content.text: ‘Nyubunyinja dingkarangka sheep kujil-kujil. Ngayu nyungun yarkinkaku kunil, sheep ngami-ngamiku warrarida.’

content: Yamba Godungku nganya juran-bungal, ngayungurr dungay yurranka jakalba bubungu Galilee.”
Peterangka Jesusanda yalaman, “Jana wubulku warrarida, yamba ngayu kari.”
Jesusangka nyungundu yalaman, “Ngayu manubajabuku yunundu balkal. Jukijuki wujurrbu kawal jambul yirrkanjiku, yundu nganya three times darrbil.”
Peterangka junkurr-murubuku yalaman, “Ngayu nguba yununji wulay, nguba kari, yamba ngayu yununku kari darrbiji.” Jana wubulduku yalarrku balkan.
Jesus Godunji balkawan gardenba.
Jana Jesus, nyungu jawun-karra, jana dungarin gardenba burri Gethsemane. Jesusangka jawun-karranda yalaman, “Yurra bundarika. Ngayu balu dungay, Godunji balkawanka.”
Nyulu Peter, James, John wundin nyungunji. Nyulu milka-bujarmanda, warrngkan-warrngkanda.
Nyulu jananda yalaman, “Ngayu milka-bujarmalarrku, yala junjuynju kulngkuldu nganya nyarril-nyarril. Yurra yaluy bundarika, miyil-janjanarikada.”
Nyulu buban dungan baja, bubungu jiba bada-bada wunan, Godundu babajinka nyulu wawu kari warrngkanka.

Nyulu Godundu yalaman, “Yundu ngayku nganjan. Yundu junjuy-junjuy balkalarrku. Ngayu wawu kari warrngkanka. Yamba yunduku nganya yungan, wulanka bamanka wubulkuku. Ngayu jananka wulayda, yala yunduku ngaykundu balkan.”
Nyulu kadan baja janandaku, nyajin warngku wunananya. Nyulu Peteranda yalaman, “Simon, yundu wanyurrinku kari buban miyil-janan?
Miyil-janay, Godundu babajika, yurra milka-jananji Dubundu. Yurra wawu ngulkurrmanka, yamba yurra kari ngulkurrmal yurrandamunduku junkurrdu.”
Jesus dungan baja, Godunji balkawanka baja, kuku yinyanguy balkan yala nyuluku jakalbaku balkan.

Nyulu janandaku kadan baja, nyajin baja warngku wunanarinku. Jana miyil kari bajaku walngajin, warngku jirray bajaku. Jana binal kari bajaku, jana wanjarrmanka baja nyungundu. Nyulu dungan baja, Godunji balkawanka baja.
Nyulu janandaku kadan baja, jananda babajin, “Yurra wunanariku? Yalada, jana yalaymbu kadarida, nganya mambarrinka bamanda buyun-buyunyundu.
Dakada, dungankada. Nyaka, nyulu kadayda, nganya mambarrinkada.”
Jana Jesus karrban.

Jesus balkan-balkawanku, Judas kadan. Nyulu jakalbaku Jesusamu jawun. Bama wubul nyungunji kadarin, naybujiku yalbaynjiku, and jukujiku kadarin. Jana, maja-maja Godundumunku bayanka, teacher-teacher ngadimunku, binga-binga, yinyarrinyangka jananin bama yungan, Jesus karrbanka.
Judasangka jananda naybujirrba balkan, jana kadanjiku Jesusanda. Nyulu yalaman, “Ngayu nyubun kissim-bungal, yinyakudabi Jesus. Nyungun karrba, wundi, nyaka-nyakaku, nyulu warrinji.”
Judas kadan, Jesusanda jinbalku dungan, yalaman, “Teacher.” Yinyamun nyulu Jesus kissim-bungan.
Jana Jesus karrban, yaykarrdaku kujin.
Yinyarrin janjanarin nyubuninja naybu yalbay sword kulban, bama milka yakan. Yinya dingkar milka yakajin, nyulu workingman majamu yalbaymu Godundumunku bayanka.
Jesusangka jananda babajin, “Yurra wanyurrinku ngaykundu jukujiku, and naybujiku kadarin? Ngayu wurrmay-baka kari.
Yurra nganya warngku yindu-yindu nyajin Godundumunbu bayanba binal-bungan-bunganya, yamba yurra yala-yalaku nganya kari karrban. Kari. Godumu kuku yinyaynka manubajamalkuda.”
Jana Jesusamu jawun-karra warrarinda, Jesus bawan.
Nyubun jawun warru, nyulu Jesus wukurril-wukurrin. Nyungundu mararr nyubunku bangkarrba. Dingkar-dingkarangka nyungun karrbanka, yamba kambiku karrban.
Nyulu warru kambi-kariku warrinda.
Jesus jakalba council-councilanda janan.

Jana Jesus wundin majanda yalbaymba Godundumunku bayanka courtcasemunku. Jana, maja-maja wubulku Godundumunku bayanka, teacher-teacher wubulku ngadimunku, binga-binga wubulku, jana murumarin yinyaymba bayanba.
Peterangka Jesus wukurrin kala-kalbaymun, kananga fencemunbu walan, majandamunbu yalbayandamunbu bayanba. Nyulu bayanga bura-kajin soldier-soldieranji.
Maja-majangka, and binga-bingangka, jana Jesus yarkinkaku kuninka. Yinyaynka jana wawu bamangka yindu-yinduynju kuku jurril dajinka Jesusanka. Yamba jananga kuku kariyirrku buyun Jesusanka.
Bama wubuldu kuku jurril dajin nyungunku, yamba jana kari agreemanijin.
Bama kanbal dakanda, kuku jurril Jesusanka dajin.

Jana yalaman, “Nganjin nyungun milkabu nyajin yalamanya, ‘Dingkar-dingkarangka ngadiku Godumu bayan ngaran, yamba ngayu yinya bayan dumbarril. Warngku kulurmal, ngayu yindu ngaral. Bamangka kari yinya bayan ngaral, ngayuku ngaral.’”
Yamba yinyarrin dingkar-dingkar kari agreemanijin.
Maja yalbay jakalba jananda dakan, Jesusanda yalaman, “Yundu jananin nyajin yunun nyuyanya. Yundu wanyu kuku dajil baja?”
Yamba Jesus jankaku bundan, kuku kariman. Majangka yalbaynja nyungundu babajin, “Yundu Godumu kangkal or kari? Yundu bama Godundumun or kari?”
Jesusangka yalaman, “Ngayukuda. Ngayu bama Godundumun. Yurra nganya nyajil bundandanya Godunji, ngalin majaku bunday. Yurra nganya jirimun nyajil kankadanya ngurrbanji.”
Majangka yalbaynja kulibu nyunguku kambi dumbarrin, yalaman, “Ngana wawu karida nyungunku balkanka baja.
Nyulu balkan nyulu Godkuda. Yurra nyungun nyajin, buyun bajaku. Yurra nyungundu wanjarrmanka?” Jana wubulduku kuku dajin, nyungun yarkinkaku kuninka, nyulu malajikuda.
Kanbalda nyungun nyumbabu daman, kanbalda nyungu miyil nandan, kunin, yalaman, “Wanjungku yunun kunin? Balka!” Soldierangka kanbalda nyungun karrban, walu kulban, bangkarr kunin marabu.
Peterangka Jesus darrbin.
Nyulu Peter bada yardmunbu bundandan, jalbu nyubun kadan, nyulu jalbu majanka yalbaynka workmanman.
Nyulu Peter nyajin bura-kajin-kajinya, nyulu nyungun kunkun-bungan, yalaman, “Yundu yinyaynji dingkaranji townmun Nazarethmun. Yundu Jesusanji bundandan.”
Yamba Peterangka yalaman, “Kari. Ngayu nyungunkuku binal kari. Yundu wanyu kuku balkal-balkal?” Nyulu gateba dungan, jukijuki yirrkanda.
Jalbungku nyungun nyajin baja, yalaman bamanda janjanarinya, “Nyulu yinyakuda Jesusanji dungan-dungan.”
Yamba Peterangka yalaman baja, “Ngayu nyungunkuku binal kari.” Bamangka janjanarinya Peteranda yalaman, “Yundukuda Jesusamu jawun because yundu yalarrku bubumun Galileemun.”
Peterangka kuli-murubuku yalaman, “Godungku nganya nyajil. Kaki ngayu kari manubajabuku balkal, nyulu nganya punishim-bungal. Ngayu yinyaynka dingkaranka binal kari bajaku.”
Jukijukikuda yirrkan baja. Peteranda milkanga kadan Jesusangkaku nyungundu yalaman, “Jukijuki kawal jambul yirrkanjiku, yundu nganya three times darrbil.” Peter milka-bujarmanda, banbadinda.
